user.title: RLTech FTTR
user.description: Configure one OLT host. Port 80 provides hardware/optical status, port 8080 provides FTTR AP and station inventory, and optional MQTT on port 8883 provides live updates.

data.enable_hardware_status: Port 80: enable hardware and ONU status

data_description.base_url: Use only the host/IP. The integration automatically uses ports 80, 8080, and 8883.
data_description.enable_hardware_status: Reads OLT CPU/memory, LAN/LAN-PON status, and ONU optical TX/RX from port 80.
data_description.legacy_hosts: Optional downstream/slave OLT hosts. Separate multiple hosts with commas, spaces, or new lines.
data_description.username: Main FTTR Web UI login used for AP inventory and station baseline.
data_description.enable_ap_polling: Disable only for unusual secondary/slave deployments.
data_description.enable_station_polling: HTTP station baseline; MQTT can make station rows fresher between polls.
data_description.enable_mqtt: Uses the same OLT host on fixed port 8883. Home Assistant's MQTT integration is not required.
data_description.mqtt_psk: Paste either hex, hex with separators, or plain text. The integration stores it internally as hex.
data_description.ap_username: Used only for direct AP actions such as reboot buttons.
data_description.ap_area_id: New AP devices are assigned to this area if they do not already have one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure RLTech FTTR
reconfigure.description: Blank password fields keep the existing stored value.
